ambient: A beat lands late and everything in the room notes it.
The room contracts, holds, and lets go.
Something skips. The visions don't pause for it.
description: You're inside the muscle that has been doing this for you your whole life without being thanked, and it has just missed one. The room is the size of that miss. It goes again a moment later and the room doesn't entirely believe it.
name: The Irregular Beat

looks: It arrives. Then it arrives. Then there's a place where one was supposed to be.
You have never once had to attend to this, and you're attending to it now.
It picks back up in a way that isn't quite an apology.
objects.name: the beat

looks: Wet, warm and working. Everything here is working very hard.
They move with it, and there's a moment where they wait as well.
They have been doing this since before you were a person with opinions.
objects.name: the walls

weather: It's blood warm and there's no air, and none has ever been required.
